findings.body: The required matcher coverage includes case variants for canonical, SAP, and display-name aliases. This test uses lowercase only for canonical codes; `DUB-NUR` and both display names retain their mapping-master case. Consequently, changing SAP/display matching from case-insensitive to case-sensitive would leave the suite green. Add lowercase or mixed-case assertions for both an SAP alias and a display alias.
findings.title: Not done: case-variant leaves for SAP and display-name matching

findings.body: This task's allowed paths are limited to the six implementation/test files, but the change also rewrites the story task decomposition and read record and modifies `.factory/stories/ASK-MULTI-PLANT/story.json` plus its task record. The handoff declares no necessary out-of-scope changes, and none of these edits is needed by the plant-rules module or its tests. Remove these independently changed planning/Factory files from this scoped patch.
findings.title: Remove the unrelated out-of-scope planning and Factory changes
